title: help-presentation.json
description: How the help module presents responder-flows.json: the start node, the fixed buttons, log lines, the crew broadcast, the readings panel, per flow levels and the ground message. Team copy and team defaults; the steps themselves come only from responder-flows.json.

notice.description: Shown on every page that renders this document's clinical content, for example: Unreviewed draft: needs clinician review before live guidance.
